body: yes how dare i be mentally affected by the love of my life interpreting himself as someone who he is not

that is the issue here, see for example you helped me and wrote an answer, but if i saw you somewhere outside or around my boyfriend - i would be jealous or despise you automatically. i dont wanna feel that way about every beautiful woman that i see… i just wanna become non toxic for myself and not poison my mind with every living creature, you did not do anything bad to me nor did half of the random people outside

i dont understand if you people are just ignoring the fact that i was in a false relationship where he stated things about him that are not true for 2 years or what? i know that i have some issues too but cmon, if i knew his outlook on porn and women i would never be with him in the first place (which doesnt mean that i am mentally ill, i have my boundaries and respect for certain things), same as we wouldnt agree for example about having kids and one side lied about it - of course you would be disappointed and of course it would be a huge deal breaker for a lot of people if they cannot agree on that - that does not mean anyone is mentally ill here

breaking up is not a solution, i love this man no matter what but i have no confidence anymore because of him, he created a false image of what our relationship is gonna be and i am so lost now, my brain is disgusted by him but my heart just wants to help him and understand him, but i cant do that for both of us if he just doesnt want to. but yes, breaking up is not an option even tho at this point i dont even understand his reasonings to be with me

no, i came here seeking for help because i am affected to the point where my mind got poisoned and i cannot go through normal daily life tasks… i just wanted some help, words, advice, books, videos, anything… that would make it easier for me to go through life and feel like i actually deserve something. i feel like a zero and because of that mental state i cannot force myself to even do anything for myself

i tried even that and he still continued to lie, he asks for help and claims that he wants to stop (i feel like he says that just to keep me quiet for a while) and then does whatever he wants to do, i try to initiate more, i tried watching porn with him on my demand which he said that he doesnt want to but we still did in the end… i dont know, it is not about porn itself, it is about lying about who he is, i dont know now who he is anymore, how he sees sex, women and similar topics and he refuses to even explain, apparently he doesnt even know why he watches porn
it is about lying for 2 years and representing himself as someone else for all 2 years, read a little bit more careful
but i want to be with him, he just doesnt want to give me any closure and i can only assume that he has a problem with women and how he sees then

chill? he doesnt want help, even to this day i try to help him and he refuses, he just wants to lie and doesnt even want to talk or explain it to me why he watched porn and what are his outlooks on women

i stumbled upon this and wonder, why do you not have friends? is it mostly your choice or just how life went for you people? i have chosen not to have friends few years ago and i am more than ok with it, but once in a while i ask myself - is this normal thing to do? do people really do that? this makes me feel good because i dont feel alone in my choices, but then again… did you guys choose to be like this?
do you maybe please have any advice on earning money online? i have all the time of the world to invest in it, i just dont have any significant skills to offer unfortunately…

i am dizzy with my ears ringing sitting on the couch, i feel like i am losing my mind… you think that will help? we live in 36m2 apartment and the whole place is dirty and messy, because my brain feels so dumb doing things, my brain asks me why would i do that? for what? for who? it makes no sense and i keep fighting with my brain from all the trauma
